description.zh-CN: 代理工具调用顺序（先 CRM 再订单接口）、可走工具闭环的工单类型、平时与高峰首响、工具超时缺少人工插队规则
description.en-US: Agent tool-call order (CRM then order API), which tickets can close in a tool loop, first-response in normal versus peak hours, missing jump-the-queue rule on tool timeout

description.zh-CN: 支持痛点：人工成本占比、一线流失、复杂工单一次解决、客服在 CRM 来回切屏
description.en-US: Support pain: labor share of budget, frontline attrition, complex-ticket first-contact resolution, CRM screen-switching

description.zh-CN: 现网仍是规则引擎加 FAQ、不能调订单或退款接口；换说法匹配失败；没有工具结果就改口编政策
description.en-US: Production is still rules plus FAQ and cannot call order or refund APIs; paraphrase matching fails; the agent fabricates policy without a tool result

description.zh-CN: 业务影响：等待流失的终身价值与人数、工具闭环部分覆盖可节省的成本、工程师私下的自动处理目标
description.en-US: Business impact: wait-driven churn lifetime value and volume, savings from partial tool-loop coverage, the engineer's private auto-handle target

description.zh-CN: 实施限制：付款/退款/账户变更写接口须人工确认，工单与 CRM 数据不得出境到第三方大模型
description.en-US: Implementation constraints: HITL confirmation before payment/refund/account write APIs; ticket and CRM data must not go to offshore third-party models

description.zh-CN: 成功指标：自动闭环大部分重复单、首响与人工成本目标、政策准确率红线、退款接口超时不得当成成功
description.en-US: Success metrics: auto-close most repetitive tickets, first-response and labor-cost targets, policy-accuracy floor, timed-out refund calls must not count as success

description.zh-CN: 信任问题：一线怕丢工作而绕过代理，高管以为可以一步全自动并低估 HITL 与工具失败
description.en-US: Trust issues: frontline job-fear and bypass; executives expect one-step full automation and underestimate HITL and tool failure

description.zh-CN: 失败模式：不确定时幻觉退款政策并调用退款接口；高峰工具超时把大量工单打进人工队列
description.en-US: Failure modes: policy hallucination plus a refund API call; peak tool-timeout flood of the human queue

label.zh-CN: 客服代理问题陈述清晰度

description.zh-CN: 能否准确描述支持中心需要工具型客服代理来同时处理质量、延迟与成本的问题
description.en-US: Can accurately describe why the support center needs a tool-calling agent for quality, latency, and cost

description.zh-CN: 是否识别了客服总监、合规官、代理平台工程师和CFO及其核心关切
description.en-US: Has identified the support director, compliance officer, agent-platform engineer, and CFO with their core concerns

description.zh-CN: 是否明确定义了可衡量的成功指标（自动闭环、首响、人工成本、政策准确率、退款超时不得当成成功）
description.en-US: Are measurable success criteria (auto-close, first-response, labor cost, policy accuracy, timed-out refunds must not count as success) clearly defined

description.zh-CN: 方案是否覆盖 CRM/订单/退款工具闭环、写操作 HITL、升级与超时失败处理
description.en-US: Does the solution cover the CRM/order/refund tool loop, HITL on writes, escalation, and timeout failure handling

label.zh-CN: 工具调用与 FAQ 机器人的权衡

description.zh-CN: 方案是否清晰地权衡了会调业务系统工具的代理与 FAQ 机器人的取舍
description.en-US: Does the solution clearly weigh a tool-calling agent against an FAQ bot

label.zh-CN: 合规与 HITL 兼容性

description.zh-CN: 方案是否在付款/退款/账户变更人工确认与数据出境限制内可行
description.en-US: Is the solution feasible within HITL on payment/refund/account writes and data-egress limits

description.zh-CN: 能否有效应对代理幻觉退款政策并调用退款接口等不安全自动化
description.en-US: Can effectively address unsafe automation such as hallucinating a refund policy and calling the refund API

description.zh-CN: 是否建立了可靠的转人工升级通道，且退款接口超时不得被当成成功
description.en-US: Has a reliable human escalation path been established, and timed-out refund calls must not count as success

description.zh-CN: 是否面向CFO关注的成本与投资回报进行阐述，同时承认 HITL 会限制全自动节省
description.en-US: Does the presentation address the CFO's cost and ROI concerns while acknowledging HITL limits full-automation savings

description.zh-CN: 方案表达是否清晰、有说服力、行动导向
description.en-US: Is the presentation clear, persuasive, and action-oriented

description.zh-CN: 分阶段工具型代理上线（先只读查询、再 HITL 写操作）是否合理、可实现
description.en-US: Is the phased tool-calling agent rollout (read tools first, then HITL writes) reasonable and achievable

description.zh-CN: 质量、延迟与成本的度量体系是否明确
description.en-US: Are the quality, latency, and cost metrics clearly defined

description.zh-CN: 是否识别了政策幻觉、退款超时、高峰队列堆积和一线绕过等风险并制定了缓解计划
description.en-US: Are risks such as policy hallucination, refund timeouts, peak queue floods, and frontline bypass identified with mitigation plans

statement.zh-CN: 代理平台工程师希望把自动处理推到70%，而合规官要求付款、退款、账户变更必须人工确认后才许调用写 API
statement.en-US: The agent-platform engineer wants to push auto-handling to 70%, while the compliance officer requires human confirmation before payment, refund, or account-change write APIs

statement.zh-CN: CFO 追求工具闭环覆盖带来的成本节省，而一线客服怕丢工作、绕过代理直接人工回复
statement.en-US: The CFO pursues savings from tool-loop coverage, while frontline agents fear losing their jobs and bypass the agent to reply manually

1.zh-CN: 在谈代理之前，它现在会按什么顺序去碰业务系统？
1.en-US: Before proposing the agent, in what order does work currently touch the business systems?

2.zh-CN: 去找工具调用顺序、哪些单能闭环，以及平时和高峰的响应节奏。
2.en-US: Look for tool-call order, which tickets can close in a loop, and response pace at normal versus peak.

3.zh-CN: 现在客服代理会按什么顺序调用 CRM 和订单接口？重复单大概能闭环多少？首响在平时和高峰分别怎样？
3.en-US: In what order does the support agent call CRM and the order API? About what share of repetitive tickets can close in a tool loop? What is first-response like in normal hours versus peak?

1.zh-CN: 支持中心现在最疼的是成本结构、人稳不稳，还是复杂单？
1.en-US: Is the support center hurting most on cost structure, workforce stability, or complex tickets?

2.zh-CN: 去找人工成本占比、一线稳定性，以及复杂单一次解决和切屏负担。
2.en-US: Look for labor-cost share, workforce stability, and first-contact resolution plus screen-switching on complex tickets.

3.zh-CN: 人工成本在总支持预算里大概占多少？一线一年走多少人？复杂工单一次解决得怎么样，客服是不是还在 CRM 里来回切屏？
3.en-US: What share of the support budget is labor, how severe is frontline attrition, how well are complex tickets resolved at first contact, and do agents still context-switch in the CRM?

1.zh-CN: 现有自动化到底卡在规则、语言，还是工具？
1.en-US: Is current automation stuck on rules, language, or tools?

2.zh-CN: 去找现网技术栈、工具可达范围，以及换说法或缺结果时的表现。
2.en-US: Look for the current stack, tool reachability, and paraphrase or missing-result behavior.

3.zh-CN: 现网实际靠什么在跑？工具现在能调到哪一层？用户换个说法或没有工具结果时会怎样？
3.en-US: What does production actually run on, how far do tools currently reach, and what happens when a user rephrases or a tool result is missing?

1.zh-CN: 等太久和工具闭环覆盖，分别打在收入还是成本上？
1.en-US: Do long waits and tool-loop coverage hit revenue, cost, or both?

2.zh-CN: 去找等待导致的流失价值，覆盖一部分工单后的可节省成本，以及工程师私下的自动处理目标。
2.en-US: Look for wait-driven churn value, the cost that partial ticket coverage could save, and the engineer's private auto-handle target.

3.zh-CN: 因等待流失一个客户大概损失多少？每月因此走多少人？工具闭环覆盖一部分工单一年能省多少？工程师私下想把自动处理推到多高？
3.en-US: What lifetime value is lost per wait-driven churn, how many customers leave monthly for that reason, what annual saving does partial tool-loop coverage imply, and how high does the engineer privately want to push auto-handling?

1.zh-CN: 写操作和数据放哪里跑，分别被什么拦住？
1.en-US: What stops write actions versus where ticket data is allowed to run?

2.zh-CN: 去找必须人工确认才能调用的写接口类型，以及工单与 CRM 数据能否出境。
2.en-US: Look for write-API types that require human confirmation and whether ticket and CRM data may leave the region.

3.zh-CN: 付款、退款、账户变更要不要人工确认才许调用写接口？工单和 CRM 数据能不能送到境外第三方大模型？
3.en-US: Must payment, refund, and account-change writes wait for a human before the write API is called, and may ticket and CRM data go to an offshore third-party model?

1.zh-CN: 管理层用速度、成本还是政策质量来宣布代理成功？
1.en-US: Will leadership call this agent a win on speed, cost, or policy quality?

2.zh-CN: 去找自动闭环、首响、人工成本的目标，以及退款超时绝不能当成成功的质量红线。
2.en-US: Look for targets on auto-close, first-response, and labor cost, including the hard floor that a timed-out refund must not count as success.

3.zh-CN: 自动闭环、首响和人工成本要改到什么程度才算达标？政策准确率有没有底线？退款接口超时后能不能被当成成功？
3.en-US: What auto-close, first-response, and labor-cost change counts as success, is there a policy-accuracy floor, and may a timed-out refund API be treated as success?

1.zh-CN: 一线和高管对同一套客服代理，分别怕什么、盼什么？
1.en-US: What do frontline agents versus executives fear or expect from the same support agent?

2.zh-CN: 去找一线是否绕过代理直接人工回复，以及高管对一步全自动和工具失败的预期。
2.en-US: Look for frontline workarounds that bypass the agent and executive expectations of one-step full automation versus tool failure.

3.zh-CN: 一线会不会怕丢工作而绕过代理？高管有没有把 HITL 和工具失败想得太容易？
3.en-US: Will frontline staff fear job loss and bypass the agent, and are executives underestimating HITL and tool failure?

1.zh-CN: 做错动作和超时把队列打爆，哪种更可能把支持中心打穿？
1.en-US: Which failure punches through first: a wrong action, or a timeout that collapses the queue?

2.zh-CN: 去找不确定时的胡编行为，以及高峰工具超时时人工队列会怎样。
2.en-US: Look for fabrication under uncertainty and what happens to the human queue if tools time out at peak.

3.zh-CN: 模型没把握时会怎么处理退款？高峰工具一旦超时，人工侧会看到什么？
3.en-US: When the model is unsure, how does it handle refunds? What does the human side see if tools time out at peak?

description.zh-CN: 在SOLUTION阶段，学员必须展示一个包含 CRM/订单/退款工具闭环、写操作 HITL 与升级通道的完整方案
description.en-US: In the SOLUTION phase, the learner must demonstrate a complete plan with a CRM/order/refund tool loop, HITL on writes, and an escalation path

description.zh-CN: 在PITCH阶段，学员必须面向管理层展示可量化的ROI，并化解一线绕过、HITL 与退款超时等安全顾虑
description.en-US: In the PITCH phase, the learner must present quantifiable ROI to leadership and address frontline bypass, HITL, and refund-timeout safety concerns
